metadata.title: Teal Duotone Album Cover with Heavy Sans-Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A teal-tinted duotone composition featuring a motion-blurred portrait in a rounded frame above massive, ultra-bold sans-serif text.
excludeWhen: delicate or serif typography is requested
clean, sharp photography without motion effects is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: The design centers on a teal-and-black duotone aesthetic. A central portrait with horizontal motion blur is encased in a rounded-corner square frame, set against a textured teal background. Below the image, massive, black, ultra-bold sans-serif lettering dominates the lower half of the composition, featuring tight tracking and a graphic floral icon integrated into the first letter.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stack of a framed image over large-scale text
Monochromatic teal color harmony across background and image
Contrast between the soft motion blur of the photo and the sharp edges of the type
Integration of a silhouette floral icon with the primary typography
coreInvariants: Rounded-corner rectangular frame for the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait occupies the top 45% of the canvas, centered horizontally. The typography occupies the bottom 50%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The word 'MUSE' in the bottom half acts as the primary visual anchor due to its scale and weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the blurred portrait, follows the vertical axis down to the smaller text, and rests on the large 'MUSE' lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous teal margins surround the central framed image, creating a breathing room that contrasts with the dense typography below.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high contrast duotone with a paper-like texture overlay.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Uniform stroke width throughout all characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter of the top line is partially obscured or replaced by a floral silhouette icon.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family weight variation or identical heavy weights for both lines.
graphicDevices: Rounded corner frame with thin black border

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Maintains geometric precision and heavy presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a teal-colored textured background. In the upper center, place a rounded-corner square frame containing a portrait of a person with longish hair in a suit, set against a floral background, all rendered in a teal-and-black duotone with horizontal motion blur.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay two lines of ultra-bold, black, uppercase sans-serif text at the bottom. The bottom line should be significantly larger than the top line. Integrate a small floral silhouette on the left side of the top line.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly teal and black?
Does the portrait have a visible horizontal motion blur?
Is the typography ultra-bold and uppercase?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the image frame
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is centered and legible despite its weight.
Ensure the duotone effect covers both the background and the framed image.
Verify the rounded corners of the image frame are smooth.
Confirm the floral icon is a solid black silhouette.
recipe.reuseFormula: Teal Duotone + Motion Blur Portrait + Ultra-Bold Sans-Serif = Brutalist Pop Aesthetic
